    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Number of playlists:", len(all_playlists))
print("Playlist IDs:", [p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists])

    for artist in artists:
        artist_song_count[artist] += 1

print("All artists sorted by count:")
for artist, cnt in sorted_artists:
